decisions.reason: As a strategic platform close to the firm's core geospatial integration business, it still offers option value, but its likely higher maintenance and sales effort and the firm's broad portfolio raise the chance of later pruning.

Mobile field data capture fits well with the firm's existing enterprise GIS solutions and customer base, so the product's uncertainty still seems worth carrying given the strong complementarity with core offerings.

The search extension is a relatively low-cost add-on and the 2019 version update suggests continuing development, so keeping the option open is more attractive than dropping it despite the firm's many alternative product paths.
